title: Make context reads enforceable
summary: Hard-gate ordered full reads and correct language/handoff contracts.
description: Implement the F018 contract across the harness-agnostic read-tracking core and Pi/MCP/Claude adapters. `packages/plan-core/src/read-tracking.ts:37-80` must track a target task's own full read separately from phase and feature reads, preserve their order, and expose an eligibility result suitable for adapters to reject mutations before writes. Update `packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts` task start/switch handlers near 4138-4357 and `packages/plan-mcp/src/index.ts` near 1154-1375; direct browser lifecycle behavior remains available to the human Web UI. Correct the injected context rule at `pi-adapter/src/index.ts:4774-4776` plus canonical `packages/plan-core/src/planner-rules.ts` and generated Claude command text in `packages/agent-plan/src/index.ts` to require task(full), phase(full), feature(full). Address blank-language fallback at `pi-adapter/src/index.ts:1552-1554`. Test the real tool content contract for phase handoffs in Pi/MCP and ensure no source change weakens public TypeScript contracts or cross-harness support.

acceptedDecisions.title: Hard-gate ordered full context reads
acceptedDecisions.decision: Agent lifecycle operations must require task_get(full=true) → phase_get(full=true) → feature_get(full=true) for the exact target lineage, in that order, before task_start or task_switch can mutate planner state.
acceptedDecisions.rationale: Advisory-only parent-read tracking allowed agents to start work without reading the task, phase, or feature descriptions and even treated a task read as implicitly reading its parents.
acceptedDecisions.implementationNotes: Keep this enforcement session-local in harness adapters, invalidate it on session start, pause, and switch, require linked requirements separately, and preserve Web UI access for the human supervisor.

tasks.title: Enforce ordered full context reads and English defaults
tasks.description:
Replace the advisory-only read-tracking behavior with an enforceable, session-local readiness check. In `packages/plan-core/src/read-tracking.ts`, distinguish compact from full reads and record timestamps/sequence for the exact task ID, parent phase ID, and parent feature ID; only task(full) → phase(full) → feature(full) qualifies a target task. Reset/invalidate this eligibility on pause and switch and on normal session reset. In Pi (`packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts`) and MCP (`packages/plan-mcp/src/index.ts`), evaluate the gate before `task_start` / `task_switch` state writes and return actionable missing-read messages without changing task status. Maintain Web UI human controls, but do not permit agent adapters to bypass the gate. Update canonical rules and generated adapter/Claude prompt text to precisely state the sequence and full reads. Change the blank chat language fallback from Italian to English in the Pi project-language flow, retaining an explicit content-language selection as the chat fallback. Extend core, Pi, MCP, Claude/agent-plan, and handoff tests; build the UI bundle and run workspace validation. Preserve the existing `handoff_show` text body behavior and test it at adapter/harness level rather than changing its successful handler.

---
**Completion summary:**
Implemented F018 context enforcement and language-default fixes. `packages/plan-core/src/read-tracking.ts` now tracks task, phase, and feature full reads independently and validates the exact task → phase → feature sequence. Pi and MCP `task_start`/`task_switch` hard-reject before mutation when sequence or linked-requirement reads are missing; Pi invalidates reads at session start and after switches, and pause already invalidates them. Compact reads no longer count. Corrected canonical rules, Pi context, MCP descriptions, Claude generated command, and active-task recap guidance. Pi language prompts now fall back to English, and legacy Pi task update/create paths cannot bypass lifecycle start. Confirmed existing Pi/MCP harness tests consume handoff text content. Reviewer findings on legacy bypasses and reversed recap order were corrected and personally revalidated. Validation passed: `pnpm test:unit` (391/391), `pnpm build`, `pnpm check`, and `git diff --check`. No commit or push performed.
